pin_row.eventDescription: One Pinterest pin with title, description, full-size image, outbound link and domain, pinner, board, created date, and its saves, repins, shares and comment count.

pin_row_basic.eventDescription: One Pinterest pin with the same fields but no engagement counts (Saves, repins and shares off, or the pin's detail could not be read).

profile_row.eventDescription: One Pinterest profile's summary for a profile URL: followers, following, pins, boards, monthly views, website and bio.
